compiler_guard_clause: 多图引用只能有一个STATE_AUTHORITY负责空间、机位、人物站位和尺度；任何含冲突建筑几何的辅助图必须删除，不能只用否定词隔离；关键洞口和道具尺寸必须用人体肩宽、身高与净空等实物关系表达。
optimization: Remove the conflicting concept reference, retain one STATE_AUTHORITY predecessor, and express the opening with shoulder width, standing height and physical clearance.
root_cause: A STYLE_ONLY concept reference contained a larger opening and leaked incompatible geometry over the predecessor state authority.

compiler_guard_clause: 群体反应中唯一剧情道具必须逐人锁定：只允许唯一所有者持有；每个非所有者必须给出双手可见的具体空手接触动作，禁止使用全员抱胸等同构姿态，尾帧只允许一个该道具。
optimization: Name the sole prop owner and give every non-owner a different explicit empty-hand contact with both hands visible and no prop-shaped object.
root_cause: Generic group protective reactions gave multiple actors similar chest-clutching poses, so the model copied the unique ledger into a non-owner's arms.

compiler_guard_clause: 连续长镜相邻关键帧必须先通过摄影机轨迹可达性检查：逐帧声明camera_side、camera_position、camera_facing与continuous_camera_path；若摄影机无法在给定时间内沿真实空间连续到达下一机位，必须删除或重建参考图，禁止只靠同一地点或同一洞口文字掩盖反打轴线冲突。
optimization: Bind camera side, position, facing and path for every adjacent pair; remove or rebuild any reference that is not continuously reachable in the allotted time.
root_cause: Adjacent keyframes kept the same aperture but placed the camera on incompatible interior and exterior axes, so the model concealed the impossible move with a cut.

compiler_guard_clause: 凡镜头含账页、药屉标签、文书、牌匾或任何可读文字面，生成提示词必须改为无字空白材质板并声明TEXT_LAYER_POST_ONLY；精确文字只允许由AgentCut真实字体层注入，禁止让图像或视频模型绘字。
optimization: Make every generated paper, drawer label, document and sign a blank textless material plate. Inject exact plot text only as a real-font AgentCut layer after generation.
root_cause: The prompt asked the generative model to depict ledger writing and medicine-drawer labels, producing pseudo-Chinese glyphs that failed the OCR hard gate.

compiler_guard_clause: 对白镜头默认执行VIDEO_AUDIO_DECOUPLED：视频提示词不得包含可被模型抄写的完整中文台词，只给口型节奏、情绪和说话时段；精确台词进入独立音频清单并由AgentCut统一字幕层渲染。
optimization: Decouple picture from speech: video prompts contain only silent performance, mouth-motion timing and emotion; exact dialogue goes to independent TTS/native audio and AgentCut renders one uniform subtitle layer.
root_cause: Including exact Chinese dialogue in the video prompt caused the model to burn captions into the source despite a no-subtitle negative instruction.

optimization: Generate and approve at least three ordered state-authority frames for contact start, counterattack midpoint and rebound tail. Lock every visible actor, contact point, body-relative scale and effect maximum before video interpolation.
root_cause: A 15-second action take used identity references plus a text timeline but no state-authority action keyframes; the model enlarged thin contact ice into a table-scale river and dropped the assassin, powder, paper wall and multi-actor causal chain.

optimization: Use the accepted predecessor as the sole state authority for the next action-state image. Declare the exact actor count, wardrobe-color count, unique role mapping and no-add/no-duplicate contract before describing the changed action.
root_cause: The transition prompt combined the accepted predecessor with four extra identity references but did not bind an exact inherited roster count, so the image model copied the gray assassin and produced five humans instead of four.

compiler_guard_clause: 凡镜头可见两名及以上角色，提交前必须生成VISIBLE_ACTOR_MOTION_LEDGER：逐人声明起点、连续路径、接触或避让对象、终点与最大静止时长；每0.5秒至少两名可见角色发生可辨身体位移，任何角色同姿态不得超过0.7秒，禁止循环手势、表情替代动作、静止背景和重复帧填时。
optimization: Compress the action budget, assign every visible actor a start position, path, contact or avoidance response, and terminal position, and require visible body displacement at sub-second intervals. Explicitly reject held poses, background freezes and gesture loops.
root_cause: The prompt named each actor's general duty but gave the model too much time and did not require measurable per-interval body displacement. The model held the foreground control pose, reduced motion to facial changes, and looped background hand gestures to fill duration.
